_comment: Single source of truth for which Claude model version the /prd pipeline uses.
Edit `tiers` to pin a different version; everything else references a tier by name.
install.sh --all copies this file into the target .claude/ dir.
Verified 2026-08-31. Pricing is per million tokens (input / output):
The [1m] suffix pins Claude Code's 1M-context variant, matching
settings.json ANTHROPIC_MODEL. Haiku 4.5 is 200K only, so it takes no suffix.
